reason: The plugin is primarily a per-session billing and usage analytics tool for DeepSeek Harness: it computes session token/cost summaries from host-side session projections, shows them in conversation UI badges and panels, and offers a settings page to edit model/provider pricing tables with peak/idle and tier options. The evidence is explicit in the repository description and package metadata, with no signs of non-UI automation or external command/control behavior.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 会话计费插件，在会话界面实时展示 token 用量与费用摘要，并提供可视化的逐轮明细和可编辑的价格表配置页。
summaries.en: dsh-meter is a DeepSeek Harness session billing plugin that shows cost and token usage metrics in the chat UI, with per-round detail views and a configurable pricing table for model cost settings.

capabilities: Per-session aggregation and display of token usage and cost metrics in the conversation UI
User-configurable pricing logic for providers/models including cache split, peak/idle windows, and tiered pricing
Session-level billing projections from host-side session log folding and projection data
Local billing API route (`/billing/api`) for catalog/turn-detail retrieval
Settings persistence and update flow for billing tables through host settings binding

reasons.code: Billing values are user-facing financial indicators, and misconfigured/updated pricing can lead to incorrect displayed charges.
The plugin defines custom host/client wiring and a local billedata route path, creating a runtime surface that depends on host-side security assumptions.
User pricing data is persisted via settings namespace and synchronized across sessions/tabs, so malformed or inconsistent settings could affect all sessions.
